subject: MeridianPay onboarding — PO number race condition & line-item remap
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia@meridianpay.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T08:12:00Z
Subject: MeridianPay vendor packet + estimated volume for PO issuance

Hi Connor / Karthik / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Attaching our completed vendor onboarding form and a CSV export of the first set of line items we'll be invoicing for the pilot period. A couple of notes up front:

- We typically request a single master PO per quarter and then submit line-item detail per invoice. For the pilot we'll need two provisional POs (one for US spend, one for EU) if possible.
- Our platform uses split billing per BU; you'll see the line_items_v1.csv flagged with BU tags and suggested spend buckets.
- On your onboarding form we flagged the spend cap as $120k per month for the US pilot and €45k/month for EU — those are soft numbers while procurement finalizes limits.

Could you confirm the expected PO numbering sequence? We've seen race conditions in some customers where an initial provisional PO gets overwritten by automated provisioning and then invoices don't match, which causes payment delays. We want to avoid that.

Attachments: meridian_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF), line_items_v1.csv (CSV).

Appreciate any guidance on how Redwood wants the line items structured to avoid rework.

Best,
Lydia Park
Head of Procurement Operations
MeridianPay
Procurement: procurement@meridianpay.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@meridianpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: MeridianPay vendor packet + estimated volume for PO issuance

Hi Lydia —

Thanks for sending everything over and for the clear callouts. Quick answers:

- We'll avoid the automated overwrite by assigning a provisional, immutable PO token before supply provisioning. Procurement (Marissa) handles the numeric assignment; I'll leave requested sequencing and BU splits to her.
- For the pilot, we can create two provisional PO numbers (US / EU). Please confirm whether you want the BU tags to be encoded into the line description or kept as a separate field in the CSV — we prefer separate fields, but we can accept either if it reduces rework.
- We will honor the proposed spend caps as provisional limits while we finalize the contract — Marissa, can you confirm the cap gating and whether a monthly soft alert vs hard block is preferred?

I'll also open an internal ticket to track the PO issuance so we don't lose the sequence if someone runs the provisioning script. Threading the ticket ID below when it's created.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lydia Park <lydia@meridianpay.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: MeridianPay vendor packet + estimated volume for PO issuance

Hi all —

Looping procurement specifics in:

- We've provisionally reserved two PO sequences: RED-PR-7832-US and RED-PR-7833-EU. These are marked as provisional and stamped as non-overwrite in our provisioning service.
- For the pilot, we prefer to keep BU tags as a separate CSV column named "business_unit". That makes ledger reconciliation easier and avoids the downstream SKUs getting concatenated.
- Regarding spend caps: we can put a soft alert at 90% and a hard block at 110% of the monthly cap. For the pilot it's fine to start with alerts only — we'll escalate to a hard block after the first billing cycle if everything looks good.

Action items for Lydia: please resend the CSV with a separate business_unit column and reissue line numbers to match the new provisional PO prefixes (i.e., start line numbers with 7832-US-001 for the US file). That will let our AP pipeline match invoices deterministically.

Connor: please create the tracking ticket and include the PO prefixes above plus a note about the soft-alert thresholds. Karthik, please confirm whether we need to re-quantize any SKU-level codes for the EU VAT tagging.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Lydia Park <lydia@meridianpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: MeridianPay vendor packet + estimated volume for PO issuance

Marissa / Connor —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the provisional PO assignments. Attached is line_items_v2.csv with the business_unit column added, line numbers remapped to the RED-PR-7832-US prefix for US rows and RED-PR-7833-EU for EU rows. I also updated the onboarding PDF to include our tax certificate and a secondary contact.

We can accept soft-alert gating for the first month. Two quick asks so we have a clean handoff to AP:

1) Can you include the provisional PO token in the AP confirmation email used by your billing pipeline? That email is the single source of truth for our finance team; if it contains RED-PR-7832-US (exact token) we can auto-match.
2) Please confirm the timestamp policy: when a line-item is split across BUs (same invoice), do you record the invoice timestamp as posted (invoice date) or the individual line item delivery timestamps? We prefer invoice date for easier cash-application on our side.

I've attached the updated CSV and the revised onboarding PDF. DocuSign link for the vendor agreement has been sent to procurement@redwood.com (see link above).

Attachments: line_items_v2.csv (CSV), meridian_vendor_onboarding_form_signed.pdf (PDF).

Best,
Lydia
